prompt: A clean a mechanics diagram of a crane hoist with a pulley block, with 3 GREEN rope segments supporting the load block. Draw the LOAD (weight) as a RED downward arrow from the load block, and the EFFORT (the hand pull) as a BLUE downward arrow on the free rope end. Because 3 rope segments support the load, the mechanical advantage is 3, so the EFFORT force is one-3th of the LOAD: draw the BLUE effort arrow exactly one-3th as long as the RED load arrow. Do NOT draw the effort arrow the same length as the load arrow. Plain background, no numbers.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a mechanics diagram of a crane hoist with a pulley block, with GREEN rope segments supporting the load block, with a red load arrow and a blue effort arrow. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image show green rope segments, a red downward arrow and a blue downward arrow? Answer NO only if those are missing or it is unrelated. Answer yes or no.

reference.q_notext: Does this image have any printed number, digit, numeral, written label or caption overlaid on it (as opposed to being purely a photograph / drawing of the scene with no text)? Answer yes if you can see ANY printed number or word, no if there is none. Answer yes or no only.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up of a pulley hoist. Write down every separate green rope strand that runs all the way from the upper block down to the lower block, working from left to right, each with a few plain words saying where it runs. Separate one item from the next with a semicolon; write no running total and nothing else. If no strand runs the whole way, write the single word NONE.
